gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-odia: Amatic SC draws every letter in one squeezed-toothpaste line, like a sign painter's brush that never changes width. And Anek Odia, a plain sans with unlatched-hook curves, takes over below with capitals barely taller than its lowercase.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-tamil: Amatic SC letters look like a single stitched thread outline. Anek Tamil, a sans-serif with big round lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped curves, lets text run on in a modern, unhurried way.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads with wide, tall bowls that stay open, a sans with a clean, approachable rhythm. But Amatic SC stays crisp with no hairlines to squint at, while Anek Telugu does the steady carrying of sentences.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anuphan: Hand-lettered and unfussy: Amatic SC has no modulation between stems and connecting strokes, just casual, quirky lines. Anuphan, a sans-serif with big round lowercase bowls and open curves, gives those lines a tidy, clear-gapped partner.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-arimo: Arimo sits tall on its mean line, a sans-serif with spacious gaps in its rounded letters. And a full page of Arimo moves along steadily, with Amatic SC's neon-tube strokes giving it a quirky lead-in.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-armata: Armata is a plain sans with spacious gaps between characters and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. And a full page of it feels unhurried, with Amatic SC's flat, contrast-free letters adding a rustic note.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-athiti: Athiti keeps a high mean line and see-through s shapes. What stands out is the line width both share: Amatic SC's squeezed-toothpaste stroke and Athiti's sign-vinyl cut, one handwritten, one sans-serif.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Rustic is the first word for Amatic SC, which looks traced with a single marker in one unvarying line. And Atkinson Hyperlegible, a plain sans with wide-set s terminals, carries running text without strain.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Quirky but steady, Amatic SC looks drawn with a technical pen, its terminals stopping far from the stem. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, a sans with open counters and stretched spacing, gives that handwriting room to breathe.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-n: Monoline throughout, Amatic SC squeezes out every letter like toothpaste in one steady line. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a plain sans with washer-big lowercase eyes, can sit modestly small under a larger Amatic SC.
